tasks.title: Swarm coordinator core (swarm.py): titles, per-slot state, CLI
tasks.description: Create scripts/swarm.py (pure stdlib). Implement SLOTS table (slot -> agent name, human label) and AGENT_TO_SLOT; title(slot, label, mode, target) rendering 'M3 - Planner' / 'M3-Helper->M1' / '[working]'; write_slot_state/read_swarm_state for _logs/swarm/m<slot>.json; CLI subcommands 'title', 'state', 'swarm' with JSON/JSON-B64 output. Paths injectable for tests. Write test/tests/test_swarm.py covering title rendering (idle/working/helper), state round-trip, missing-dir handling, CLI output.

tasks.title: Swarm coordinator: stale-peer scan + atomic claim
tasks.description: In scripts/swarm.py add find_stale_tasks(inbox, own, stale_seconds) -> list of lagging peer tasks (unclaimed .task files older than stale N, excluding own agent, oldest first) and claim_task(inbox, agent, by) performing an atomic move so the first helper wins (returns claimed path or NONE). Add CLI subcommands 'find-stale' and 'claim'. Extend test_swarm.py: fresh tasks not lagging, old unclaimed task is lagging, own task never suggested, first-claim-wins, missing inbox -> empty.

tasks.title: Swarm coordinator: feedback loop + brief digest
tasks.description: In scripts/swarm.py add append_feedback/load_feedback for _logs/swarm_feedback.jsonl (JSONL records {ts, slot, agent, mode, ok, duration, task, target?}) and build_brief(...) producing a deterministic short swarm brief (recent activity + live helpers). Add CLI subcommands 'feedback' and 'brief'. Extend test_swarm.py: append/load round-trip, load_recent_n, brief includes activity/helpers, empty-file handling.

tasks.title: Worker: swarm loop, helper takeover, live titles, brief prepend, prompt hardening
tasks.description: Update scripts/run_agent_worker.ps1: add -NoSwarm (default: swarm ON), -NoBrief, -StaleSeconds (default 20), -MaxHelpers (3), -HelpCoolDown (15). After own task (or when idle) run find-stale/claim; when a peer task is claimed, execute it with the PEER's agent+model (domain-preserving), stream to the peer's log, record feedback mode=helper with target; update window title live (M3-Helper->M1) via Set-TabTitle + persist slot state; prepend 'SWARM CONTEXT' brief to the next prompt unless -NoBrief; sanitize prompts (ConvertTo-SafeTask: strip control chars/quotes, collapse whitespace) and add '--' guard for dash-leading prompts. Keep -Smoke and non-swarm behavior identical (no swarm when -Smoke or -NoSwarm).

tasks.description: Stage and commit the swarm feature on branch feature/auto-learning-setup (single-purpose commits: swarm.py module+tests, worker+bat wiring, web/GUI guards, README, secret removal).
